keyboard_observations: From the focused native selector, Tab moved to load-button; Enter submitted the current selection.
With the HTTP failure visible, Tab moved from load-button to retry. Both controls showed a 3px violet focus outline.
Enter activated Retry and focus returned to the visible load-button; the failed request remained an honest error.
console_observation: Only expected simulated HTTP 500 and ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE resource failures; no uncaught application exception was listed.
limitations: No screen reader, complete WCAG audit, physical touch device, live backend or broad design-quality comparison. Keyboard activation was exercised at 1440px; all-width DOM behavior and layout used the shared browser assertions.
